cards.answer: LeBlanc is an AP assassin and mage who deals magic damage. She combines marks and follow-up spells with a dash that can return her to its starting location.
cards.counterplay: Limit follow-up hits after her mark lands, and watch her return location before chasing.

cards.priority_reason: Her mark follow-up and return mobility define how to approach her.

cards.answer: Mirror Image triggers at low health, briefly making LeBlanc and her clone invisible. The clone deals no damage.
cards.counterplay: Avoid committing damage until you have identified the real LeBlanc.

citations.quote: Innate: When LeBlanc reaches low health, she creates a clone of herself and together they enter brief invisibility.

cards.answer: Sigil of Malice deals magic damage and marks its target. Her next damaging ability against that target consumes the mark for additional magic damage. If the initial hit or mark detonation kills the target, she recovers the mana cost and part of the remaining cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Back away from follow-up spells while marked.

citations.quote: Active: LeBlanc projects an orb at the target enemy, dealing magic damage and marking them for a short time.

cards.priority_reason: The mark makes follow-up spell hits especially threatening.

cards.answer: Distortion dashes to a location and deals magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival. She can briefly recast it to blink back to her starting location.
cards.counterplay: Keep away from her landing area and account for her return location when chasing.

citations.quote: She leaves behind a return pad at her original location that lasts a few seconds, during which she can recast. Recast: LeBlanc blinks to the return pad.

facts.claim: She can briefly recast it to blink back to her starting location.

cards.priority_reason: Her dash and return strongly affect engagement and pursuit.

cards.answer: Ethereal Chains deals magic damage and tethers the first enemy hit, revealing them. If the tether remains intact, it deals additional magic damage and roots the target, keeping them revealed during the root.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the chain or move away from LeBlanc to try to break the tether before the root.

citations.quote: Active: LeBlanc flings an illusory chain in the target direction that deals magic damage and tethers the first enemy hit, revealing them.

facts.claim: If the tether remains intact, it deals additional magic damage and roots the target, keeping them revealed during the root.

cards.priority_reason: Maintaining the tether adds damage and immobilizes the target.

cards.answer: Mimic repeats her most recently used basic ability with the same effects and modified magic damage. Mimicked Distortion has an independent return location, and mimicked Chains can tether a target already affected by her basic Chains.
cards.counterplay: Track her latest basic spell and prepare for a repeat; account for additional return options after a mimicked dash.

citations.quote: Active: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of her most recently used basic ability, applying the same effects and dealing modified magic damage.

facts.claim: Mimic repeats her most recently used basic ability with the same effects and modified magic damage.

Ethereal Chains and Mimic: Ethereal Chains are separate debuffs, and can both be tethered to the same target without overriding each other.

facts.claim: Mimicked Distortion has an independent return location, and mimicked Chains can tether a target already affected by her basic Chains.
